Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1173
Claimant:
James Powell

2024-11-06
First notice of loss came in reporting a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection. The driver involved is named on
the policy, and the vehicle was towed to a repair facility for inspection.
2024-12-17
Claimant's counsel confirmed representation and asked that all contact go through their office. Scene photos were
uploaded, and they confirm some of the details the parties have described.
2024-12-23
The vehicle inspection is complete. The damage to the rear bumper and trunk area is mostly in line with the described
impact, and nothing found so far suggests earlier damage. The repair estimate is under review.
2025-01-06
Initial medical records describe a neck strain, and the kind and force of the crash fit that injury well. No prior treatment
to the same body area appears in the records received so far.
2025-01-13
Recorded statement taken from the claimant through counsel. The account matched the first notice and every earlier
conversation. It is still unclear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting at impact, so a follow-up question was
sent.
2025-01-14
No independent witnesses have come forward, so the file rests on the parties' accounts and the photos. Treatment
has run somewhat longer than usual for this injury, and complete treatment records for the full period have been
requested.
2025-01-25
Coverage was confirmed in force at the time of loss, and nothing suggests the damage predates the policy start. The
claim stays open pending the outstanding treatment records and the response to the follow-up question.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
